name: JVC HR-3300 VHS home video recorder
description: A consumer videocassette recorder for recording and playing home video using VHS.

impact.note: Launch machine of the format that took existing home video recording into households in many countries; longer tapes and wider adoption, with format successors.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: The JVC HR-3300 was sold in Japan on 31 October 1976.

evidence.supports: Museum dates HR-3300 Japanese sale to 31 October 1976.
Tokyo museum identifies 1976 model, two-hour capacity and 256,000-yen price.

events.caveats: Sale date is scoped to Japan; listed price is not an observed transaction.
